The design is fixed and all tests pass (`TEST PASSED`). Two bugs were present in `rtl/timer_irq.v`:

1. Auto-reload loaded `reload_val - 1` instead of `reload_val`, shortening every subsequent period by one cycle.
2. The irq flag checked `irq_clr` before `expire`, giving clear priority over set instead of the spec's required set-priority.
